overview.description: The Zacks Income ETF (ZINC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in high dividend yield equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF that invests income-producing securities that have paid interest or dividends over the past year. The fund may invest in ADRs, REITs, MLPs, Canadian royalty trusts and foreign stocks. ZINC was launched on Jun 2, 2026 and is issued by Zacks.
